newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan stocks surge to highest level in two years.
newsitem.headline: Jordan stocks surge to highest level in two years.

text.p: Jordan's stock market rose on Sunday to its highest level in nearly two years, fuelled by undiminished global fund appetite for blue-chips, dealers said.

The official 60-share Amman Financial Market (AFM) index rose 1.36 percent to 164.35 points in strong trade worth 4.5 million dinars ($6.4 million) dominated by emerging fund buying on a handful of mining and bank stocks.
